challenges.title: Cascade
challenges.tagline: Cosmic-ray air showers over the high desert
challenges.summary: An interactive Monte Carlo of cosmic-ray air showers that runs in the browser. Showers are tracked particle by particle, then replayed in 3D over real terrain north of Reno, Nevada, and compared with a citizen observatory's own measurements.
challenges.imageAlt: A 1 PeV proton shower striking the ground under a night sky
